 Wolverhampton motorists urged to allow extra time for Wolves v Cardiff City at Molineux 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Motorists in Wolverhampton are being warned of heavier traffic around Molineux this afternoon as Wolves host Cardiff City in the Championship.
 West Midlands Roads said routes close to the stadium would be busier before kick-off and after full-time.
 OneFootball Videos
 The match at Molineux starts at three pm today, October 31.
 Travellers are advised to allow extra time for journeys through the city.
 Drivers have also been urged to check their travel plans ahead of the fixture.
 Source: ExpressAndStar.com
